config.description: Hostname of the Qlik Sense node, no scheme (e.g. sense.example.com).

config.label: 'certificate' (service identity via QMC-exported certs) or 'jwt' (per-user, through a JWT virtual proxy)
config.description: 'certificate' (service identity via QMC-exported certs) or 'jwt' (per-user, through a JWT virtual proxy). Defaults to certificate.

config.label: Path to the QMC-exported client certificate (PEM)
config.description: Path to the QMC-exported client certificate (PEM). Required in certificate mode; also enables the Proxy-API session tools in jwt mode.

config.label: Path to the client certificate private key (PEM)
config.description: Path to the client certificate private key (PEM).

config.label: Path to the Qlik root CA (PEM)
config.description: Path to the Qlik root CA (PEM). Supply it to keep TLS verification on.

config.label: Signed JWT for the virtual proxy (jwt mode only)
config.description: Signed JWT for the virtual proxy (jwt mode only).

config.label: Virtual proxy prefix for jwt mode, e
config.description: Virtual proxy prefix for jwt mode, e.g. 'jwt'.

config.label: Set true to register write tools
config.description: Set true to register write tools. Default false: mutating tools are never registered, so the tool list is genuinely read-only.

config.label: Comma-separated personas to expose: analyst, developer, admin
config.description: Comma-separated personas to expose: analyst, developer, admin.

config.label: Set false only for self-signed lab certificates
config.description: Set false only for self-signed lab certificates. Leave on in production.
